title: Beyond the Output: Faithful XAI for Medical Image Report Generation
content: AI systems for medical imaging have advanced rapidly, yet two reliability problems persist: hallucination, where models generate content unsupported by the image, and unfaithful explain- ability, where stated reasoning does not reflect actual model behavior. This survey argues that these are not separate problems — they are symptoms of the same underlying gap. Drawing on 27 papers across explainability in Vision Transformers, medical report generation, and hal- lucination detection, we show that current systems treat these areas independently, leaving no mechanism to connect visual evidence, model reasoning, and output correctness. We further argue that faithfulness in explanation can serve as an early signal for hallucination: a model that is not grounded in the image will produce explanations that reveal it.
